mapper.insert: insert into ledger(ledger_name, create_time) values (#{ledgerName}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
insert into user_ledger_relation(user_id, ledger_id, create_time, is_owner,is_default) values (#{userId}, #{ledgerId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 1,1)
mapper.select: select ledger_id from user_ledger_relation where user_id = #{userId} and is_default = 1

select ubr.*,user.username AS ownerName,ledger.ledger_name from user_ledger_relation ubr left join user on user.id = ubr.user_id left join ledger on ledger.id = ubr.ledger_id where ubr.user_id = #{userId}
select is_owner from user_ledger_relation where user_id =#{userId} and ledger_id = #{ledgerId}
